Aisha (PM): Quick sync — we need to finalize prioritization and PRD acceptance criteria for the Optimize toolkit (batching / caching / quantization). Customer asks piling up: per-route batching controls, prefix/KV cache tunables, and on-the-fly quant toggles for Dedicated customers. Can we align on what MUST ship first and concrete acceptance criteria?

Marco (Eng): +1. From runtime side, per-route batching is the biggest infra change. Rough estimate: 2–3 sprints to get safe dynamic batching + fallback. Acceptance criteria I care about: dynamic batch_size override, burst window support, and deterministic fallback to single-request path when latency SLO fails.

Tess (ML Eng): For quantization profiles we need an eval gating system. PRD should require: an eval harness (50 representative prompts per customer), automated regression check (e.g., embedding cosine >= 0.98 or generation quality delta <= 2%), and a rollback flag. Also include guidance on model families we support (FP16, int8, int4) and known failure modes.

Jun (Platform Eng): Caching: must ship with audit logs and TTL controls. Default TTL = 24h, but customer override required. Need clear spec on what constitutes cacheable data (no PII by default unless opt-in + KMS for private caches). Edge case: streaming responses with partial KV states — define semantics.

Sophie (ProdOps): Launch checklist items: docs + console controls, per-route telemetry (latency, cost/token, cache hit rate), rollout plan (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%) and automatic rollback on error rate/regression. Also need runbook entries for common incidents.

Aisha (PM): Helpful. Proposed priority (must/should/can):
1) Must: per-route batching controls + basic telemetry + fallback SLOs (unblocks enterprise Dedicated customers)
2) Should: KV/prefix cache with TTLs, audit logs, and console toggles
3) Can: automated quant rollouts + on-the-fly toggles and quant profiles for model families

Marco (Eng): Example per-route config we expect in PRD — add to RFC: 
```
route: /generate/chat
batching:
  enabled: true
  max_batch_size: 64
  burst_window_ms: 150
  latency_slo_ms: 120
  fallback: single_request
```
We should require the runtime to emit events for batch formation and SLO breaches.

Tess (ML Eng): Acceptance criteria for quantization feature (to be included in PRD):
- Quantized model passes regression harness on customer-supplied prompts (>= 98% embedding similarity on eval set)
- No more than 2% degradation in downstream task metrics (when available)
- Automated A/B canary with rollback when regression detected

Jun (Platform Eng): Edge cases to include in PRD: long context sessions where KV cache growth must be bounded (max entries per session), short high-QPS small payloads (ensure batching doesn't add >20ms p95), and cross-region fallbacks when cache miss rates spike.

Aisha (PM): Good — also add customer-driven acceptance scenarios: e.g., RetailCo needs per-route batching disabled for their webhook flows, BankCorp requires cache TTL <=1h + KMS encryption for cached keys. Include these as explicit test cases.

ops-bot: Created issue #4792: "optimize-toolkit: PRD acceptance criteria draft" and assigned to @Marco, @Tess, @Jun.

Marco (Eng): I'll own batching RFC + runtime telemetry. Will post draft RFC by Thu EOD.

Tess (ML Eng): I'll draft quant profiles + eval harness spec. Will include suggested prompt sets and metric thresholds.

Jun (Platform Eng): I'll write caching spec + audit/KMS requirements and the platform rollout steps.

Sophie (ProdOps): I'll assemble launch checklist and runbooks. Happy to review PRD. :thumbsup: 

Aisha (PM): Thanks — next steps: owners post their RFC sections to the PRD doc, include explicit acceptance criteria and edge-case tests, and we reconvene Fri morning to lock scope. Please call out any blockers in the thread.

Marco (Eng): blocker: need earlier access to Dedicated testbed for lifecycle testing.

Aisha (PM): Noted — I'll request slot from infra and cc @ops.

Sophie (ProdOps): Adding: ensure metrics names and dashboards are in the PRD (cost_per_token, batch_size_histogram, cache_hit_rate).

Tess (ML Eng): Also add quality monitoring: continuous eval every deploy against canary prompts.

Aisha (PM): Perfect — I'll update PRD after RFCs land. Thanks all. :rocket:
